svg.text: Top plate 150 x 60 x 8 on the post; top 813 up, centre 150 behind the drum axis

svg.text: Side frames 556 apart, centre to centre; cross rails front and rear

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
